BiblicalUsage: The word is to break in pieces, in Aramaic. Daniel tells Nebuchadnezzar that as the toes of the feet were part of iron and part of clay, so the kingdom shall be partly strong and partly broken.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a kingdom mixed with clay will break where it is weak, and the iron cannot save it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
